key: You're gonna need to stop right there.
en: You're gonna need to stop right there.
ja: そこで止まってもらおうか。

key: Guess our chances flew the coop.
en: Guess our chances flew the coop.
ja: アマ: どうやら、チャンスは逃げちまったみたいだな。

key: Go ahead. See what happens.
en: Go ahead. See what happens.
ja: やってみろよ。何が起きるか見てやる。

key: Pick a god and pray!
en: Pick a god and pray!
ja: 好きな神様選んで、祈っとけ!

key: ...W-what?
en: ...W-what?
ja: クリストファー: ……な、何だと?

key: For heaven's sake, go to hell.
en: For heaven's sake, go to hell.
ja: 頼むから、地獄に落ちろ。

key: And you've made it this far? Some of your friends weren't so lucky...
en: And you've made it this far? Some of your friends weren't so lucky...
ja: ここまで来たのか? お前の仲間の中には、そんなに運が良くなかった奴もいたけどな……

key: Ahaha... Adorable, really.
en: Ahaha... Adorable, really.
ja: ミンタ: あはは……本当に可愛いこと。

key: Well, go on~ We have nothing to fear.
en: Well, go on~ We have nothing to fear.
ja: さあ、どうぞ~ こっちは何も恐れることないから。

key: Eh? What are you doing here?
en: Eh? What are you doing here?
ja: は? ここで何してるわけ?

key: You don't know what's good for you...
en: You don't know what's good for you...
ja: チャド: 身のためになることが、わかってないな……

key: Think I held you up enough?
en: Think I held you up enough?
ja: 十分足止めできたと思うか?

key: VICTORIA: It looks so much bigger on the inside...
en: VICTORIA: It looks so much bigger on the inside...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 中に入ると、外から見るよりずっと大きいですね……

key: FLORINIA: Perception is inherently subjective to and thus influenced by those parts to which it is relative and adjacent.
en: FLORINIA: Perception is inherently subjective to and thus influenced by those parts to which it is relative and adjacent.
ja: フロリニア: 知覚とは本質的に主観的なものであり、それが相対し隣接する部分によって影響を受けるものである。

key: AMARIA: Yep!
en: AMARIA: Yep!
ja: アマリア: そうだね!

key: Whatever that means, but, yep!
en: Whatever that means, but, yep!
ja: どういう意味かわかんないけど、まあ、そうだね!

key: This place has been sectioned off quite a bit...
en: This place has been sectioned off quite a bit...
ja: ここはかなり区画分けされてるみたいだね……

key: But we're all well-equipped here!
en: But we're all well-equipped here!
ja: でも、こっちの装備は万全だよ!

key: What do you say we split up and hunt for whatever's caused all this?
en: What do you say we split up and hunt for whatever's caused all this?
ja: 手分けして、これを引き起こしたものを探すってのはどう?

key: Even if something happens, it's not like we'll be too far apart!
en: Even if something happens, it's not like we'll be too far apart!
ja: 何かあっても、そんなに離れてるわけじゃないし!

key: VICTORIA: That's fine with me. I'm sure we can handle it.
en: VICTORIA: That's fine with me. I'm sure we can handle it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それで構いません。きっと対処できるでしょう。

key: And if something does happen, how big can this place really be?
en: And if something does happen, how big can this place really be?
ja: それに、何かあったとしても、ここがそんなに広いはずもありませんし。

key: I'm sure we can call the others over quickly enough.
en: I'm sure we can call the others over quickly enough.
ja: すぐに他の人を呼べるはずです。

key: FLORINIA: Affirmative.
en: FLORINIA: Affirmative.
ja: フロリニア: 了解である。

key: As leaders, Amaria and this speaker should take the path most likely to encounter hostile resistance-- the center.
en: As leaders, Amaria and this speaker should take the path most likely to encounter hostile resistance-- the center.
ja: リーダーであるアマリアと本話者は、敵対的抵抗に遭遇する可能性が最も高い経路――すなわち中心部を進むべきである。

key: Supporting parties should begin by securing the perimeter of the area.
en: Supporting parties should begin by securing the perimeter of the area.
ja: 支援部隊は、まず区域の外周の確保から始めるべきである。

key: Should confounding elements appear, inform this speaker posthaste.
en: Should confounding elements appear, inform this speaker posthaste.
ja: 予想外の要素が現れた場合は、直ちに本話者に報告せよ。

key: AMARIA: If anything happens to you guys, we'll be there in a jiffy!
en: AMARIA: If anything happens to you guys, we'll be there in a jiffy!
ja: アマリア: あんたたちに何かあったら、すぐに駆けつけるから!

key: VICTORIA: Got it.
en: VICTORIA: Got it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わかりました。

key: FLORINIA: Very well. Let us begin.
en: FLORINIA: Very well. Let us begin.
ja: フロリニア: よろしい。開始する。

key: AMARIA: Stay safe~
en: AMARIA: Stay safe~
ja: アマリア: 気をつけてね~

key: VICTORIA: I guess it's up to us to start with the edges of this place?
en: VICTORIA: I guess it's up to us to start with the edges of this place?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ここの端の方から始めるのは、私たちの役目みたいですね?

key: VICTORIA: I'll take this way, you take the other?
en: VICTORIA: I'll take this way, you take the other?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 私はこっちを行くので、あなたはあっちを?

key: With any luck, we'll all meet up momentarily anyway.
en: With any luck, we'll all meet up momentarily anyway.
ja: 運が良ければ、どうせすぐに全員合流できるでしょうし。

key: Then I'm off!
en: Then I'm off!
ja: それじゃ、行ってきます!

key: ???: Pathetic.
en: ???: Pathetic.
ja: ???: 哀れなものだな。

key: ???: Are you truly the best defense this wretched city can muster?
en: ???: Are you truly the best defense this wretched city can muster?
ja: ???: これが、この惨めな街が用意できる最良の防衛だとでも?

key: VICTORIA: Tch, I can't believe I lost so quickly--
en: VICTORIA: Tch, I can't believe I lost so quickly--
ja: ヴィクトリア: くっ、こんなにあっさり負けるなんて――

key: And after I was able to find Borealis, too...
en: And after I was able to find Borealis, too...
ja: せっかくボレアリスを見つけられたのに……

key: BOREALIS: To say "you lost" is a flagrant understatement.
en: BOREALIS: To say "you lost" is a flagrant understatement.
ja: ボレアリス: 「負けた」とは、あからさまな控えめ表現だな。

key: A more accurate description would be that you barely managed to show up to the fight in the first place.
en: A more accurate description would be that you barely managed to show up to the fight in the first place.
ja: より正確に言えば、お前はそもそも戦いに現れることすら、かろうじてできた程度だった。

key: Do not glorify your meager performance here with a result as if there were any competition to begin with.
en: Do not glorify your meager performance here with a result as if there were any competition to begin with.
ja: まるで最初から競争があったかのように、その貧弱な結果を美化するな。

key: You are out of your depth.
en: You are out of your depth.
ja: お前には手に負えないのだ。

key: For you to come here was folly most moronic.
en: For you to come here was folly most moronic.
ja: ここに来たことこそ、最も愚かしい過ちだった。

key: What did you even think someone like you could accomplish?
en: What did you even think someone like you could accomplish?
ja: お前ごときに、一体何が成し遂げられると思っていたのだ?

key: VICTORIA: I thought, with the others...
en: VICTORIA: I thought, with the others...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 皆と一緒なら、と思っていました……

key: BOREALIS: The others, from whom you've allowed yourself to be separated.
en: BOREALIS: The others, from whom you've allowed yourself to be separated.
ja: ボレアリス: その皆から、自ら離れることを許した、というわけか。

key: VICTORIA: To protect the city--
en: VICTORIA: To protect the city--
ja: ヴィクトリア: 街を守るために――

key: BOREALIS: This city, which festers like a wound in the earth.
en: BOREALIS: This city, which festers like a wound in the earth.
ja: ボレアリス: この街は、大地の傷のようにうみを持っているだけの場所だ。

key: In both ends and means, you demonstrate naiveté.
en: In both ends and means, you demonstrate naiveté.
ja: 目的においても、手段においても、お前は未熟さを露呈している。

key: You play pretend hero for the sake of ideals which have no basis in reality, and upon a foolish pride that insists even a misguided action is better than none.
en: You play pretend hero for the sake of ideals which have no basis in reality, and upon a foolish pride that insists even a misguided action is better than none.
ja: 現実に根拠のない理想のために、そして誤った行動でも何もしないよりましだと言い張る愚かな自尊心のために、お前はヒーローごっこを演じているにすぎない。

key: This was the only possible outcome.
en: This was the only possible outcome.
ja: これは、唯一あり得た結末だ。

key: Yet, what is done is done.
en: Yet, what is done is done.
ja: だが、終わったことは終わったことだ。

key: You cannot be allowed to report what you've seen today.
en: You cannot be allowed to report what you've seen today.
ja: 今日見たものを報告させるわけにはいかない。

key: Crobat.
en: Crobat.
ja: クロバット。

key: We will take her some place secure.
en: We will take her some place secure.
ja: 彼女を、どこか安全な場所へ連れて行く。

key: You'll find no shortage of time to reflect upon your myriad mistakes in captivity.
en: You'll find no shortage of time to reflect upon your myriad mistakes in captivity.
ja: 囚われの身となれば、数々の過ちを振り返る時間には事欠かないだろう。

key: ???: I TOLD you they would get here too soon!
en: ???: I TOLD you they would get here too soon!
ja: ???: だから言ったのに、こいつら早く来すぎだって!

key: If you had made this machine go faster...
en: If you had made this machine go faster...
ja: この機械をもっと速く動かしてたら……

key: ???: No! Tangrowth wouldn't be able to take anymore!
en: ???: No! Tangrowth wouldn't be able to take anymore!
ja: ???: だめだ! モジャンボがこれ以上耐えられない!

key: ???: The speed has already been optimized.
en: ???: The speed has already been optimized.
ja: ???: 速度は、すでに最適化済みだ。

key: Be glad the Pokémon was able to capture the Leaders.
en: Be glad the Pokémon was able to capture the Leaders.
ja: このポケモンがリーダーたちを捕らえられただけでも、感謝すべきだろう。

key: ???: You're really strong to be able to do everything so well, Tangrowth!
en: ???: You're really strong to be able to do everything so well, Tangrowth!
ja: ???: そんなに何でもうまくやれるなんて、本当に強いんだね、モジャンボ!

key: ???: Hey! How much longer are we gonna ignore the other problem?
en: ???: Hey! How much longer are we gonna ignore the other problem?
ja: ???: おい! もう一つの問題、いつまで無視するつもりだ?

key: ???: Oh, hello. Um, my name is Lumi--
en: ???: Oh, hello. Um, my name is Lumi--
ja: ???: あ、こんにちは。えっと、僕の名前はルミ――

key: ???: Only four of you entered? We expected more.
en: ???: Only four of you entered? We expected more.
ja: ???: 入ってきたのは四人だけか? もっといると思っていたが。

key: Four are easily dealt with.
en: Four are easily dealt with.
ja: 四人程度なら、簡単に片付く。

key: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduced ourselves. I'm--
en: ???: Um, it might be more polite if we introduced ourselves. I'm--
ja: ???: あの、自己紹介した方が礼儀正しいと思うんですけど。僕は――

key: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi.
en: ???: You've already introduced yourself, Lumi.
ja: ???: もう自己紹介は済んだだろ、ルミ。

key: Needlessly, at that!
en: Needlessly, at that!
ja: しかも、必要もないのにな!

key: I, however, am the one in charge here-- Zero!
en: I, however, am the one in charge here-- Zero!
ja: だが、ここを取り仕切ってるのはオレだ――ゼロだ!

key: ???: I am Eve.
en: ???: I am Eve.
ja: ???: 私はイヴ。

key: Collectively the three of us are referred to as ZEL.
en: Collectively the three of us are referred to as ZEL.
ja: 私たち三人をまとめて、ゼルと呼びます。

key: Zel: And we're not gonna let you touch the PULSE!
en: Zel: And we're not gonna let you touch the PULSE!
ja: ゼル: それに、PULSEには指一本触れさせないからな!

key: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right?
en: zeL: But that's probably what you came here for, right?
ja: ゼル: でも、たぶんそれが目当てで来たんですよね?

key: All of the growth here is a result of this machine.
en: All of the growth here is a result of this machine.
ja: ここの成長は、全部この機械のせいなんです。

key: And Eve built it all by herself!
en: And Eve built it all by herself!
ja: しかも、イヴが全部一人で作ったんですよ!

key: zEl: Correct. The Link System is a simple hybridization-amplification mechanic.
en: zEl: Correct. The Link System is a simple hybridization-amplification mechanic.
ja: ゼル: その通り。リンクシステムは、単純な混成増幅機構です。

key: Zel: So with that machine behind it, it can manipulate even the smallest root into a massive arbor wrecking ball!
en: Zel: So with that machine behind it, it can manipulate even the smallest root into a massive arbor wrecking ball!
ja: ゼル: あの機械があれば、どんな小さな根っこでも、巨大な破壊兵器の樹木に変えられるんだ!

key: Think you can stop it? Just try!
en: Think you can stop it? Just try!
ja: 止められると思うか? やってみろよ!

key: ...This is why you shouldn't talk so much, Lumi!
en: ...This is why you shouldn't talk so much, Lumi!
ja: ……だから　しゃべりすぎるなって言ったんだ、ルミ!

key: zEl: Zero, next time, rather than showing off the mission's keystone, let's fight with our own Pokémon.
en: zEl: Zero, next time, rather than showing off the mission's keystone, let's fight with our own Pokémon.
ja: ゼル: ゼロ、次からは、任務の要を見せびらかすんじゃなくて、自分たちのポケモンで戦いましょう。

key: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened.
en: zeL: I'm sorry, Tangrowth... I should have intervened.
ja: ゼル: ごめんね、モジャンボ……僕が止めるべきだった。

key: Zel: Stop yelling at me!
en: Zel: Stop yelling at me!
ja: ゼル: オレに文句言うな!

key: You said this machine was supposed to make it stronger!
en: You said this machine was supposed to make it stronger!
ja: この機械があれば強くなるって、お前が言ったんだろ!

key: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor.
en: zEl: Your misjudgment was the key factor.
ja: ゼル: あなたの判断ミスが、主な要因です。

key: Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress.
en: Regardless, with Tangrowth incapacitated, the malignant growth will now regress.
ja: いずれにせよ、モジャンボが戦闘不能になった以上、この悪性の成長は後退していくでしょう。

key: zeL: So it's all going to go back to normal?
en: zeL: So it's all going to go back to normal?
ja: ゼル: それじゃ、全部元通りになるの?

key: zEl: Correct.
en: zEl: Correct.
ja: ゼル: その通りです。

key: Thus, it is counter-productive to remain here.
en: Thus, it is counter-productive to remain here.
ja: したがって、ここに留まるのは非生産的です。

key: Let us recover the unit and abscond amidst the regression.
en: Let us recover the unit and abscond amidst the regression.
ja: 装置を回収し、後退が始まっている間に姿を消しましょう。

key: Zel: Hey, \PN, right?
en: Zel: Hey, \PN, right?
ja: ゼル: おい、\PNだったよな?

key: Don't think this is over, or anywhere near it.
en: Don't think this is over, or anywhere near it.
ja: これで終わったなんて思うなよ、まだまだ全然だ。

key: You might've caught us at the germinal stage this time, but you don't stand a flower's chance in flame at taking us down for real.
en: You might've caught us at the germinal stage this time, but you don't stand a flower's chance in flame at taking us down for real.
ja: 今回は芽生えの段階で捕まえられたかもしれないけど、本気のオレたちを倒すなんて、お前には万に一つも無理だからな。

key: Don't forget it!
en: Don't forget it!
ja: 忘れんなよ!
